description: 한국철도공사_역 위치 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사가 운영하는 간선 철도역의 위치 정보를 제공하며, 각 역의 위도와 경도, 그리고 출입구 개수 등 주요 항목을 포함하고 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 철도역 위치 정보, 위도 및 경도, 출입구 개수, 지역본부별 관할, 공간 분포 분석. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
